schedule.name: Adult: chronic liver disease
schedule.description: Chronic liver disease, including hepatitis B or C, cirrhosis, fatty liver and autoimmune hepatitis. Applies on top of the adult age schedule only for patients a clinician has put on it; its rules replace the age rule for the same vaccine.

rules.why_text: CDC adult schedule 2025, chronic liver disease: 2-dose HepA series (Havrix 6 to 12 months apart, Vaqta 6 to 18), or 3-dose HepA-HepB (Twinrix)

rules.review_reason: Hepatitis B: 2, 3 or 4 doses depending on the vaccine used (2 doses for Heplisav-B). Dialysis uses the dialysis formulation. Check the series.
rules.why_text: CDC adult schedule 2025, chronic liver disease: chronic liver disease is a hepatitis B risk factor: complete the series, at any age

rules.review_reason: Pneumococcal: choose PCV15 (then PPSV23 at least 1 year later; 8 weeks if immunocompromised), PCV20 or PCV21. Check earlier PCV13 and PPSV23 doses first.
rules.why_text: CDC adult schedule 2025, chronic liver disease: age 19 or older, 1 dose of PCV15, PCV20 or PCV21 if no earlier conjugate vaccine

rules.review_reason: Age 50 to 74 with chronic liver disease (for example cirrhosis): 1 dose RSV vaccine. Confirm the condition qualifies.
rules.why_text: CDC adult schedule 2025, chronic liver disease: 1 dose RSV vaccine at 50 to 74 with increased risk
